name: Send-later message
description: A message queued with send --at waits as a member of due:<owner> carrying its msg_id. The lifecycle pass claims, writes, then removes it, so a watcher dying at any step repeats the write and the receiver shows it once.

meanings.queued: Member in due:<owner>, no live claim.
meanings.claimed: claim:<owner>:<msg_id> held by one watcher for 120 s.
meanings.written: XADDed into the target inbox with the stored msg_id; still in due:<owner>.

transitions.guard: Valid time and address; ZADD due:<owner>
Due time reached, lifecycle lock held, SET claim NX succeeds
Watcher died or the XADD failed; 120 s
Target key is this owner's own from:<owner> key
Next pass writes again with the same msg_id; the receiver drops the repeat
